result.instructions: Tools for Pin Payments, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which charges failed last week?"; "What are my available and pending balances?"; "Show my latest deposits and their amounts.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Pin Payments data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run pinpayments_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run pinpayments_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run pinpayments_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. pinpayments_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: pinpayments_get_balance
tools.title: Get balance
tools.description: The current Pin Payments account balance: available (ready to transfer) and pending (available plus estimated funds from charges that have not settled yet), per currency, in the currency's base unit (cents for AUD). GET /balance.

tools.name: pinpayments_list_charges
tools.title: List charges
tools.description: List charges (card payments), 25 per page: amount (in the currency's base unit, e.g. cents for AUD), currency, description, payer email, status_message/success, total_fees, merchant_entitlement, amount_refunded, captured, settlement transfers, chargebacks flag, metadata. The card is shown only as scheme and last four digits. GET /charges.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1); 25 results per page. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pinpayments_search_charges
tools.title: Search charges
tools.description: Search charges by free text (description, email, metadata, cardholder name, currency, exact amount in the currency's base unit, exact charge/card/refund/customer token) and/or a created-date range. GET /charges/search.

start_date.description: Created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1); 25 results per page. Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: pinpayments_get_charge
